description: Parameter dictionary for the Causal Seal reference pilot. Defines the meaning, value domain and AUTHORITY of each governing-state parameter. Authority answers: who was in a position to know this field?

authority_values.observed: the emitter directly observed the value at generation time
authority_values.asserted: supplied to the emitter without independent verification
authority_values.derived: computed by the emitter from other state
authority_values.attested: produced/verified by a trusted control plane

engine.model_revision.meaning: immutable model revision/digest when the serving path exposes one; alias-only otherwise
